# Pritesh Rathod - Full Portfolio Details

> Python Backend Developer specializing in FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, and Golang microservices. Building scalable backend systems and AI/LLM-powered applications.

## About

Pritesh Rathod is a Python & Go Backend Developer with a growing focus on AI systems and production-ready applications. He is currently pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Applications & Information Technology at Gujarat University, and specializes in building scalable backend solutions using FastAPI, LangChain, and LangGraph. His recent work has focused on RAG pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and AI platforms such as Zentriom, as well as computer vision applications like VideoRedact. He is based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

## Projects

### VideoRedact: Automated Video Privacy Tool
Automated video privacy redaction application that uses YOLO object detection and OpenCV to detect and blur faces and license plates in video streams and recorded files.
Technologies: Python, OpenCV, YOLO, FastAPI

### AI Voice Assistant
Web-based AI voice assistant that understands natural language commands. Built with SvelteKit, FastAPI, Python, NLP (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), and the Web Speech API.
GitHub: https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/ai-voice-assistant

### BuildTrack: Construction Management System
A role-based construction management system that digitizes project planning, attendance tracking, cost estimation, and reporting, improving transparency and efficiency across admins, members, and clients. Built with Flask, Python, MySQL, and Bootstrap.
GitHub: https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/BuildTrack-construction-management-system

### Netflix Watchlist API
RESTful API built with Go and MongoDB for managing a movie watchlist. Supports CRUD operations, watch status updates, and ObjectID handling using a clean MVC-style architecture. Built with Go, MongoDB, Gorilla Mux.
GitHub: https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/go-mongodb-crud-api

### Medical RAG Chatbot
AI medical chatbot using Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Pinecone vector search, and Groq LLM for accurate health Q&A. Built with Python, LangChain, Pinecone, Groq, LLaMA 3, Sentence Transformers.
GitHub: https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/end-to-end-medical-chatbot-generative-ai
